ResearchTabDef.label: EcoTech: Lithic
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Unlock lithic terratech projects, such as those based on crystals, metals, and precious ores.\n\nYou can have both a basic and an advanced project active at the same time. If no advanced project is active, advanced research will contribute to a basic project instead.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Lithic Essentials: Materials
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to properly create and grow Terrathyst; a crystal that forms an ever-strengthening lattice the more of it that is present, making it a infinitely usable material in terms of viability. Also teaches how to make a terrathyst crucible. Teaches you how to grow a terrathyst crucible, which is used to create basic lithic items. Nature is not only verdant plants and trees, but also the earth, primal elements, and even the cosmos. Terrathyst is just another terratech technique, and has it's own unique upsides and downsides, which tribes might prefer over organic matter. Terrathyst production takes slightly longer than organic production, due to their terrain sensitivity, and the need for many shards. However, their ease of understanding and shaping is just as simple as Prima creations, and terrathyst serves as the dominant material.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: You can now create a terrathyst crucible, and growths of terrathyst, which is your primary method of creating crystal-based structures and weapons. These are easy to grow, and don't require high fertility. They will grow in glowsap and shocksap bays. This crucible is used to form terrathyst seeds, and to charge or manipulate certain terrathyst items. It's usability is quite limited, however, and stronger, deeper structures are needed for larger items, and more demanding recipes.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Fundamental Lithic Applications
ResearchProjectDef.description: Records tell of various materials that are entirely natural, but seem to have no presence on the planet. Even though some methods of dense terrathyst is common terratechnology, far denser materials - some not even lithic - once existed. \n\nUpon researching, you will discover some information about possibilities known to exist, but not known to any on the Rimworld. This research currently doesn't grant anything; however, should it's contained knowledge ever come within reach, this information will help you achieve it quickly.
